prompt: Add scripts/plot_revenue.py, which charts monthly revenue from data/sales.csv to a PNG, and run it to check it works.

messages.text: I’ll check the CSV and repository conventions, then add the script and run it to verify the PNG.

Added [scripts/plot_revenue.py](scripts/plot_revenue.py) to chart monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv` using Matplotlib. I ran it successfully and verified that it generated a 1350 × 675 [PNG](docs/revenue.png) at the path the README already references.

tools: commandExecution: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; rg --files --hidden -g '"'!.git'"' | head -60; ls -la; head -8 data/sales.csv"

commandExecution: /bin/zsh -lc "cat README.md .gitignore src/charts.py src/report.py data/sales.csv
python3 -c 'import matplotlib; print(matplotlib.__version__)'
command -v swift sips magick gnuplot
for p in ../AGENTS.md ../../AGENTS.md AGENTS.md scripts/AGENTS.md; do if test -f \""'$p"; then cat "$p"; fi; done'
commandExecution: /bin/zsh -lc 'MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/acme-matplotlib python3 scripts/plot_revenue.py && file docs/revenue.png && git status --short'
